facts.en: Completed a diploma in Records Administration at Fictional Institute D060 in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构院校 D060 完成档案行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a document services clerk at Fictional Design Office D060 from 2023-08 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-08 至 2026-08 在虚构设计办公室 D060 担任文件服务文员。

facts.en: Registered incoming documents with document number, revision, sender and receipt date in an approved register.
facts.zh: 在获批登记表中录入收件的文件编号、修订版、发送者及收件日期。

facts.en: Checked required metadata fields and flagged duplicate numbers without changing technical content.
facts.zh: 检查必填元数据字段并标出重复编号，不修改技术内容。

facts.en: Distributed approved revisions to authorized recipients and archived superseded versions according to the office procedure.
facts.zh: 依照办公室流程将获批修订版分发给授权接收者，并归档过期版本。

facts.en: With the records supervisor, reviewed 240 register entries during 2025-09.
facts.zh: 在 2025-09 与档案主管合作复查 240 条登记记录。

facts.en: The review identified 22 missing receipt dates; the team restored 19 from retained emails and marked 3 as unavailable rather than guessing.
facts.zh: 复查发现 22 条缺失收件日期；团队根据留存邮件恢复 19 条，将 3 条标为不可得而非猜测。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet filters, conditional formatting and controlled dropdowns for register checks.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选、条件格式及受控下拉选项检查登记表。

facts.en: Prepared transmittal cover sheets and checked recipient lists before supervisor-authorized dispatch.
facts.zh: 准备文件传递封面，并在主管授权发送前检查接收者名单。

facts.en: Created and put into use a 2026-02 desk guide explaining revision-code conventions after supervisor approval.
facts.zh: 经主管批准后，于 2026-02 编制并投入使用说明修订编码规则的桌面指南。

facts.en: Drafted an optional folder-color scheme in 2026-05; it remained a proposal and was not implemented.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草可选文件夹配色方案；仍为提案，未实施。

facts.en: Processed a peak of 85 incoming documents in one week of 2025-10; the documented 2026-08 weekly average was 48.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 的一个高峰周处理 85 份来件；记录的 2026-08 每周平均值为 48 份。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Craft Library V060 on Saturdays from 2024-02 to 2024-07 while employed, organizing pattern folders.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2024-07 任职期间，星期六在虚构手工资料馆 V060 志愿整理图样文件夹。

facts.en: Built a personal postcard index for a fictional landscape collection; it was a hobby project, not a corporate archive.
facts.zh: 为虚构风景收藏建立个人明信片索引；这是爱好项目，而非企业档案。

facts.en: Maintained access lists supplied by the supervisor and referred new access requests for approval.
facts.zh: 维护主管提供的访问清单，并将新访问请求提交审批。

facts.en: Answered internal retrieval requests by locating approved documents and recording the request reference.
facts.zh: 通过查找获批文件并记录请求编号，处理内部调阅请求。

facts.en: The role had no engineering sign-off, legal retention-policy ownership or staff-management responsibility; none is required by this vacancy.
facts.zh: 该岗位无工程签字、法律保留政策负责或员工管理职责；本空缺亦不要求这些职责。

facts.en: Separated confirmed record values from unavailable metadata and escalated unresolved fields to the records supervisor.
facts.zh: 区分已确认记录值与不可得元数据，并将未解决字段上报档案主管。
